cluster_summary: This cluster comprises vulnerabilities in Jenkins where authorization checks are missing or incorrectly scoped, authorization logic is bypassed due to flawed assumptions, sensitive data is exposed through serialization of full user objects, and CSRF protection is missing on GET endpoints. These issues allow unauthorized access to sensitive information and state-changing actions.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 1 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Replace the domain object with a simple identifier string and reconstruct the object only when needed..

mechanism.missing_guard: the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect
mechanism.name: Sensitive data exposure via serialization
mechanism.sink_shape: the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs
mechanism.typical_fix: Replace the domain object with a simple identifier string and reconstruct the object only when needed.
